title: Privacy Policy
description: What data I Need Save processes when you use this website, which cookies and analytics it uses, and your rights over your personal data.
body:
I Need Save (ineedsave.com) is a free tool for downloading videos, photos, and audio from social media, run by Abid Hanan Wicaksono. This policy explains what data we process when you use this website and how we handle it. We deliberately collect as little as possible: you don't need to sign up, log in, or give your name or email to use the service.

Data we process

  • Links you paste. A link is sent to our server only to find the media that can be downloaded. We don't store links in a database or connect them to your identity.
  • Media files. Whenever possible, your browser downloads a file directly from the original platform's servers (for example Instagram, Facebook, or X). When a file has to be processed (for example, joining video and audio or converting to MP3), or when the platform doesn't allow direct downloads, it is streamed through our server to your device without being stored.
  • Technical data. Like almost every website, our hosting provider (Vercel) logs technical request data, such as IP address, browser type, and time of access, for security and operations. These logs are kept only temporarily under Vercel's policies.
  • Article statistics. View, like, and share counts are stored as totals per article, without any data that identifies you.

Cookies and browser storage

  • ins-lang: remembers the language you chose, for one year.
  • dl_…: a temporary cookie lasting a few seconds that marks a download as started.
  • Local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage): remembers the articles you liked and stops one visit from being counted twice. This data stays on your device.
  • Third-party analytics cookies from Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity, described below.

Analytics

We use analytics tools to understand how the website is used and to improve it:

  • Vercel Web Analytics: anonymous visit statistics without cookies.
  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): uses cookies to measure the pages you open, your approximate country, your device type, and events such as clicks on download buttons. The data is processed by Google under the Google Privacy Policy.
  • Microsoft Clarity: loaded once you start interacting with the page. Clarity records interactions such as clicks and scrolling for heatmaps and session recordings, and masks what you type into input fields. The data is processed by Microsoft under the Microsoft Privacy Statement.

You can opt out of analytics by blocking third-party cookies in your browser settings, using a tracker blocker, or installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. The website remains fully usable.

Third-party services

  • Vercel Inc. provides hosting. Its servers may be located outside your country.
  • Google Fonts is used to display some scripts (for example Arabic, Thai, or Japanese). When a font loads, your IP address is visible to Google.
  • The media's original platform. When a file is downloaded directly, that platform can see your IP address, just as when you open the content yourself.
  • Share buttons (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) only contact those services when you click them.

Security and sharing

All connections to this website use HTTPS. We don't sell, rent, or trade personal data. Data is shared only with the service providers above, as far as needed to run the website, or when required by law.

Children

This service is not intended for children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect personal data from children.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law No. 27 of 2022 or the EU GDPR), you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data and to withdraw consent to processing. Because we store almost no data that identifies you, most requests can be handled simply by clearing the cookies in your browser. For data processed by Google or Microsoft, you can also use the privacy settings of their services. For anything else, contact us.

Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated from time to time. Changes take effect when published on this page, with the effective date shown at the top.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent through the contact links at the bottom of every page or via abidhanan.my.id.
